name: cloudtrail:StopLogging on * (boundary, multi-finding)
note: StopLogging on Resource "*" is both a detection-impairment grant and a generic broad-resource grant, so the rule catalog produces DETECTION-IMPAIRMENT AND WILDCARD-RESOURCE on this one statement (exactFindingIds is the pre-correlation rule set). IAM-201 then folds the same-statement WILDCARD-RESOURCE INTO the more-specific DETECTION-IMPAIRMENT finding as a risk factor, so the authoritative (post-correlation) findings show ONE DETECTION-IMPAIRMENT row with the broad-resource scope captured as a risk factor rather than a duplicate WILDCARD-RESOURCE row.

compound.note: IAM-201: the WILDCARD-RESOURCE on statement 0 is the broad-resource scope of the co-located DETECTION-IMPAIRMENT capability, so it is folded in as a risk factor instead of a separate top-level row.
